name: codex-model-team
description: A reusable Codex workflow for coordinating specialized project-local coding agents.

interface.longDescription: Coordinate a project-local team for software development. The skill guides Codex through codebase exploration, architecture planning, implementation, independent code review, and optional UI or documentation checks. It can also set up project-local agent TOML files under .codex/agents/. It does not install agents globally, run background services, or guarantee that a particular model is available on every account; model IDs and reasoning settings can be adjusted for the current Codex environment.
